newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends firm vs dlr, Ecu futures busy.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends firm vs dlr, Ecu futures busy.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended calm trade firmer against the dollar at 151.22/27 from opening levels, dealers said.

"It was a quieter day than yesterday," said Ervin Csengeri of Inter-Europa Bank. "The forint moved up to 35 points weaker than the bid, which provoked lots of offers, bringing it back to around 20 pips."
The forint opened on Thursday at 151.30. The national bank's resistance level stood at 151.11 at the close.
